reason: The README describes a plugin for creating, managing, and dispatching scheduled DeepSeek Harness agent tasks with configurable workspaces, permissions, and durable run history.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、管理并按计划执行智能体任务的自动化插件。
summaries.en: An automation plugin for creating, managing, and scheduling agent tasks in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Dispatch standalone agent runs on recurring or one-time schedules
Select workspace, model, skills, and read-only or workspace-write permissions
Persist task definitions and run history
Execute saved prompts in a workspace
